description:
I travelled to the Sundarbans national park to embark on an epic adventure.  This is a side of Bangladesh I had no clue about.   The first of a 2 part video, in this episode I discover life on board a boat and go in search of tigers deep in the heart of the mangrove forest.

With special thanks to Bengal Logistics Ltd for making this happen - utterly amazing trip. 

0:00 coming up
0:18 Introduction
00:31 Arriving at Mongla port
00:48 Boarding a small boat and leaving port
1:05 Getting on our Sundarbans passenger boat
1.25 Seeing my cabin for the first time
1:46 Tour of the boat
2:03 Meeting crew and having a refreshing drink
3:05 I discover what goes on below deck
4:19 Checking out the back of the boat, plus the upper deck
4:40 Meeting the assistant captain
4:59 Taking control of the boat
5:39 Snack time!  Green coconut juice and guava!
7:09 Amazing chef cooking on the boat - it's pomfret and crab!
8:33 a vegetable I don't recognise - potol?
9:50 Food is served - one of the best meals I have had in Bangladesh
12:43 I spot a dolphin
13:11 Arriving in the heart of the mangrove forest
15:09 Time for tiger spotting
16:51 What's it like for the forest guards?  It's tough
19:22 We spot something....
19: 38 A huge deer with massive antlers
21:20 Making sure my guard is alert
23:22 Heading to a narrow waterway to watch the sunset

🟢 Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/carrie_patsalis
🟢 Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/global_llama

This is one of many upcoming videos from my current travels in Bangladesh .  You can find the growing playlist here:  http://bit.ly/3EZ0RM0

#sundarbansnationalpark #khulna  #sundarbans
